patch_description: Inspired by the two prior seeds' heavy parameter-sharing philosophy (collective RY+ZZ+RZ achieving 20 params, and the symmetry-broken variant at 32 params), this candidate pushes parameter economy further by collapsing to just 2 distinct trainable angles per block: a single shared RY "tilt" applied to all 8 qubits, and a single shared ZZ "twist" applied along a linear chain (7 edges instead of the 8-edge ring used previously). Dropping the ring-closing edge and the separate RZ layer removes one full parameter and several gates while keeping full entangling connectivity across repeated blocks (since each block's chain composes with the next). The key insight: since RZ diagonal rotations commute with the ZZ (also diagonal) and only affect relative phase before measurement in the Z-basis correlators, a separate global RZ layer contributes redundant expressivity per block when many blocks are stacked — removing it should preserve accuracy while cutting total parameters from 18 (3 per block) to 12 (2 per block), for a total of 14 trainable parameters (12 circuit + gain + bias), notably below the best prior result of 20.
